Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
1. You can tap the Tower of London to gain 1 pool whenever an action that
requires Necromancy is successful. Is this only specifically *action cards*
that require Necromancy, or could you use this with any action that requires
Necromancy, such as recruiting a Shambling Horde or equipping with a piece of
hypothetical equipment that required Necromancy to equip with?

2. Superior Compel the Spirit gives the rescued ally/retainer X life, where X
is the amount of life printed on the card. What do you do in situations where
there are 2 different life totals printed, like with Shambling Horde or Raven
Spy?

Thanks,

Peter D Bakija

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Peter D Bakija" <pd...@aol.comANTISPAM> wrote in message
news:20020310212520...@mb-co.aol.com...

> 1. You can tap the Tower of London to gain 1 pool whenever an action that
> requires Necromancy is successful. Is this only specifically *action
cards*
> that require Necromancy, or could you use this with any action that
requires
> Necromancy, such as recruiting a Shambling Horde or equipping with a piece
of
> hypothetical equipment that required Necromancy to equip with?

It is not limited to action cards, any action that requires Necromancy
qualifies, so you can use ToL when recruiting a Shambling Horde.

> 2. Superior Compel the Spirit gives the rescued ally/retainer X life,
where X
> is the amount of life printed on the card. What do you do in situations
where
> there are 2 different life totals printed, like with Shambling Horde or
Raven
> Spy?

Card text:

Name: Compel the Spirit
[DS, FN]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Necromancy
+1 stealth action. Only usable if a retainer or ally you control has been
burned since your last turn.
[nec] Move the card from your ash heap to your hand.
[NEC] Move the card from your ash heap to your ready region, even if this
vampire doesn't meet the requirements, if any, of the card (use the normal
version if it requires a Discipline). Move X life counters from the blood
bank to the card, where X is the number of life printed on the card. If a
retainer is chosen, it must be placed on the acting minion.

Use the life for the [inf] version of the discipline.
